summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term indices and high-beta tech, evidenced by massive call premiums in SPX, NVDA, and PLTR (P/C ratios as low as 0.08). Notable directional conviction is seen in MSTR, with over $1B in 2028 LEAPS (100C and 110C strikes) and massive SPX call accumulation at the 7000 and 8400 strikes. Persistent interest is concentrated in ultra-long-dated SPX 7000C and 8000C positions, which have seen billions in accumulation over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in MSTR and SPX, while monitoring SNDK for potential downside volatility following $540M in heavy 2028 put accumulation.
